# 613 Honey Blonde Body Wave Bundles

Bring bright, sun-kissed color to your look with this 613 light blonde body wave bundle. Made from 100% unprocessed Brazilian virgin hair, each bundle offers a soft, silky texture and a natural-looking sheen.

## Features Built for Full, Versatile Style

Each 12A grade bundle weighs about 95 grams and features double-weft construction for a thick, full appearance. Three bundles suit an 8 to 16 inch install, and four bundles cover 18 to 26 inch lengths for a full head.

## Benefits for Everyday Confidence

The tight, neat wefts blend easily with natural hair or a wig, so you can wear a seamless, polished look. The body wave holds its shape with gentle care, giving you curls that stay defined through the day.

Because the hair is unprocessed and chemical-free, you can dye, bleach, perm, curl, or straighten it to match your vision. Its minimal shedding and low tangling make everyday maintenance simpler.

## Why Choose This Bundle

Sourced directly from a professional hair factory, this hair skips the middle markup, so you get quality hair at a fair price. Whether you're refreshing your color or building a new style, this bundle gives you the foundation to create it.

**Add this 613 body wave bundle to your cart today and start styling with hair you can count on.**
